memories.title: Memories
memories.subtitle: durable facts, decisions, lessons, and preferences — scoped by project, recalled by meaning

recall.title: Recall
recall.subtitle: hybrid vector + BM25 retrieval (RRF-fused), scoped by project
recall.noMatches: no matches — try rephrasing or widening the scope.
recall.runFirst: run a recall to see results.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.subtitle: recurring cross-session tool workflows, mined from ~/.claude/projects — n-gram + containment dedup + quality score
patterns.empty: no recurring workflows found. need ≥2 sessions × ≥3 occurrences.

distill.title: Distill
distill.subtitle: Extract memory candidates straight from sessions — search any local agent session, preview, then apply selectively (local rules only, no LLM).
distill.advanced: Advanced: paste or load a transcript file
distill.footer: Rules extract explicit signals only (decisions/preferences/root causes/facts); maybe band never auto-merges — review in Memories.

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.subtitle: diagnose and recover the memory store. read-only by default — rebuild needs exclusive access, so stop the server and run <1>hippo doctor --rebuild</1> from a terminal.
doctor.issueOrphanVec: {{count}} orphan vectors (vec rows pointing at deleted memories)
doctor.issueOrphanMem: {{count}} memories missing a vector (recall will skip them)
doctor.issueFts: fts drift {{drift}} (memories vs memories_fts row counts)

graph.title: Graph
graph.subtitle: semantic similarity network — nodes are memories, edges link memories with similarity ≥ {{threshold}}
graph.empty: not enough memories to build a graph (need ≥ 2).

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.subtitle: memory accumulation over time — grouped by month

compile.title: Compile
compile.subtitle: render memories into agent-native markdown (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / .cursor/rules) so coding agents auto-load them. edit memories in hippo, recompile, every tool stays in sync.
compile.previewHint: preview is read-only — click "write files" to generate the files on disk.

team.title: Team Memory
team.empty: No team memories yet — run a scan or wait for team events

tour.title: Welcome to hippo workbench
tour.subtitle: Four core actions over sessions × memories — every page is one outlet of the same kernel
tour.s1b: The Sessions page aggregates all local agents (zcode/Claude Code/Codex/opencode/pi) with workspace→project cascade filters and full transcript viewing
tour.s2b: The Distill page: search any session → preview candidates → apply selectively; or hit Distill right in a session's detail drawer
tour.s3b: The Memories page manages everything (edit/delete/source-session jump); Recall does semantic search; Graph shows the similarity network
tour.s4b: The Team page manages two-layer agent-team memories (private + shared) with promotion and retirement approvals
